question_cn: 车对王将死必须发生在：
question_en: In rook vs. king, checkmate must happen on:

options.text_en: The edge or corner of the board
The file where the rook stands

explanation_cn: 边线/角落是将死的必要条件。中心的王有四个方向可逃，边线的王只有两个方向，角落的王只有一个方向——这就是为什么要把对方王往边上逼。
explanation_en: Edge/corner is required for mate. A central king has 4 escape directions; an edge king has 2; a cornered king has 1.
